name: Mons Bank A/S
summary: Mons Bank A/S provides banking products and services to private, business, and association customers. The company offers housing loans, car loans, wealth management, local pool investment, mutual funds, share savings accounts, pension/insurance services, and mobile and online banking services. It operates through branches in Næstved, Rønnede, Præstø, and Vordingborg. The company was founded in 1877 and is headquartered in Stege, Denmark.
